say:1:1221011001:0.text: Do you see this?! His wounds have all been healed, with not even a scar left!
say:1:1221011001:0.source_cn: 你们看到了吗？！伤员身上的伤口全都愈合了，而且一点痕迹...

say:3:1221011002:1.text: It's... it's true! Apart from still being asleep, he looks as if he was never injured at all...
say:3:1221011002:1.source_cn: 真、真的！除了还没苏醒之外，他简直就像完全没受过伤一样……

say:5:1221011004:1.text:
I'm not sure either...
These strange creatures that carried me here must be linked to this!
say:5:1221011004:1.source_cn: 我也搞不清楚……\n是这群怪家伙把我扛到这里的，说不定...

choice_prompt:6:1221011004.text:
I'm not sure either...
These strange creatures that carried me here must be linked to this!
choice_prompt:6:1221011004.source_cn: 我也搞不清楚……\n是这群怪家伙把我扛到这里的，说不定这事和它们有关！

say:7:1221011005:0.text: Doesn't matter what they are. I bet they healed the injured man by some strange means to lure us in! This could be a trap!
say:7:1221011005:0.source_cn: 随便它们是什么花。要我说，肯定是它们用诡异的办法治好了...
say:7:1221011005:0.male: Doesn't matter what they are. I bet they healed the injured man by some strange means to lure us in! This could be a trap!
say:7:1221011005:0.female: Doesn't matter what they are. I bet they healed the injured man by some strange means to lure us in! This could be a trap!

say:9:1221011006:0.text: But given the situation, it seems the glimmerblooms really have healed him...
say:9:1221011006:0.source_cn: 不过看现在的情况，的确是荧荧花治好了伤员……
say:9:1221011006:0.male: But given the situation, it seems the glimmerblooms really have healed him...
say:9:1221011006:0.female: But given the situation, it seems the glimmerblooms really have healed him...

say:10:1221011008:0.text: But I don't understand, why would they do this?
say:10:1221011008:0.source_cn: 可我想不明白，它们为什么要这样做？

say:11:1221011009:0.text: Why don't you ask them directly? They seem to speak human language, though I could barely understand a word...
say:11:1221011009:0.source_cn: 你、你要不直接问它们？它们好像会说人话，虽然我完全没听懂……

say:14:1221011011:0.text: ...Hold on, why are you pointing at me? What's this got to do with me?!
say:14:1221011011:0.source_cn: ……等一下，你为什么指着我？这和我有什么关系？！

say:15:1221011012:0.source_cn: 你想要，所以，荧荧花，帮你！

say:16:1221011013:0.text: I... what did I wish for?

choice_prompt:17:1221011013.text: I... what did I wish for?

say:18:1221011014:0.text: Uh... I suppose I did, but it was purely out of sympathy.
say:18:1221011014:0.source_cn: 呃……我好像是有这么想过，但那只是出于同情罢了。
say:18:1221011014:0.male: Uh... I suppose I did, but it was purely out of sympathy.
say:18:1221011014:0.female: Uh... I suppose I did, but it was purely out of sympathy.

say:19:1221011019:0.text: By the way, you um... flowers... even though you're helping, why just heal his wounds? Can't you wake him up too?
say:19:1221011019:0.source_cn: 话说回来，呃……那什么花。就算你们要帮我，为什么只治好...

say:21:1221011021:0.text: Glimmerblooms, wake up medicine, can't make...

say:22:1221011022:0.text: Don't look at me! I only know how to haul things, not brew potions!
say:22:1221011022:0.source_cn: 你们、你们不要看我啊！我只知道卖力气搬东西，烹饪和炼药...

say:23:1221011023:0.text: How about you? Do you know how to do this? Give me a hand!
say:23:1221011023:0.source_cn: 你们呢？知道怎么做吗？帮帮忙吧！

choice_prompt:24:1221011023.text: How about you? Do you know how to do this? Give me a hand!
choice_prompt:24:1221011023.source_cn: 你们呢？知道怎么做吗？帮帮忙吧！

say:25:1221011024:0.text: Thanks! You're way more dependable than the Whispers!
say:25:1221011024:0.source_cn: 谢了！你比刚刚那几个血薇帮的家伙可靠！
say:25:1221011024:0.male: Thanks! You're way more dependable than the Whispers!
say:25:1221011024:0.female: Thanks! You're way more dependable than the Whispers!

say:29:1221011025:0.text: Let's talk after I get the injured guy back and clear my name; I have nothing to offer right now.
say:29:1221011025:0.source_cn: 等带着伤员回去，证明了我的清白再说吧，我现在也拿不出什...
say:29:1221011025:0.male: Let's talk after I get the injured guy back and clear my name; I have nothing to offer right now.
say:29:1221011025:0.female: Let's talk after I get the injured guy back and clear my name; I have nothing to offer right now.

say:30:1221011026:0.text: In any case, let's prepare the potion. Saving him is what matters!
say:30:1221011026:0.source_cn: 不管怎么样，先把药做出来吧。救人要紧！
say:30:1221011026:0.male: In any case, let's prepare the potion. Saving him is what matters!
say:30:1221011026:0.female: In any case, let's prepare the potion. Saving him is what matters!

choice:24:1:2.text: How do you plan on thanking me?
choice:24:1:2.male: How do you plan on thanking me?
choice:24:1:2.female: How do you plan on thanking me?

choice:17:0:1.text: Wished for the injured to heal?
choice:17:0:1.male: Wished for the injured to heal?
choice:17:0:1.female: Wished for the injured to heal?

say:32:1221011015:0.text: So, he entered the forest to find the member of the Carmine Whispers. The glimmerblooms really helped!
say:32:1221011015:0.source_cn: 这么说来，他进入森林就是为了找血薇帮的人。荧荧花真的帮...
say:32:1221011015:0.male: So, he entered the forest to find the member of the Carmine Whispers. The glimmerblooms really helped!
say:32:1221011015:0.female: So, he entered the forest to find the member of the Carmine Whispers. The glimmerblooms really helped!

say:33:1221011016:0.text: Yeah! Find him! Let him heal!

say:34:1221011017:0.text: Wow, these glimmerblooms really know what you're thinking!
say:34:1221011017:0.source_cn: 哇，这些荧荧花真的知道你在想什么！

say:35:1221011018:1.text: That's only natural, right? He's severely injured—who would wish him harm?
say:35:1221011018:1.source_cn: ……这很正常吧。他都重伤成这样了，难不成还盼着他出事吗？

choice:17:1:2.text: You tried to find the injured?
choice:17:1:2.male: You tried to find the injured?
choice:17:1:2.female: You tried to find the injured?

say:38:1221011007:0.text: From the look of it, that seems to be the case.
say:38:1221011007:0.source_cn: 看现在的情况，确实是这样呢。
say:38:1221011007:0.male: From the look of it, that seems to be the case.
say:38:1221011007:0.female: From the look of it, that seems to be the case.

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 难道是荧荧花治好了他？
